items.title: flowable flowable-engine JuelScriptEngine JuelScriptEngine.java importFunctions code injection

items.summary: BusyBox through 1.38.0 contains an absolute path traversal vulnerability in tftpd that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access files outside any intended directory when started without a DIR argument. Attackers can send RRQ or WRQ packets with file names beginning with '/' to read sensitive files like /etc/shadow or overwrite files, typically as root.
items.title: BusyBox through 1.38.0 tftpd Absolute Path Traversal via networking/tftp.c

items.summary: cnpmcore 3.46.0 before 3.84.3 and 4.0.0 before 4.37.3 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain upstream registry authTokens via the GET /-/registry endpoints lacking AdminAccess middleware. Attackers can request /-/registry or /-/registry/:id and replay the leaked authToken as a Bearer credential to enumerate, download, or publish packages upstream.
items.title: cnpmcore 3.46.0 before 3.84.3 and 4.0.0 before 4.37.3 Registry authToken Disclosure

items.summary: Prismor before 1.57.0 contains a wildcard CORS misconfiguration and missing authentication in its local HTTP API that allows remote attackers to overwrite security policies via cross-origin requests. Attackers can lure a developer to a malicious page that sends PUT requests to /api/policy/global or /api/policy/project, disabling AI agent guardrails and reading session and event data.
items.title: Prismor before 1.57.0 Cross-Site Policy Overwrite via Wildcard CORS Local API

items.summary: RayLabsHQ gitea-mirror before 3.38.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the /api/sso/providers handlers that allows any authenticated user to access other users' SSO providers without ownership checks. Attackers can read every OIDC client secret in clear text and overwrite or delete providers, redirecting authorization and token endpoints to attacker-controlled servers.
items.title: RayLabsHQ gitea-mirror before 3.38.1 Authorization Bypass via SSO Provider API

items.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in gf_rtp_parse_amr that allows remote RTP senders or malicious RTSP servers to read beyond packet buffers by sending crafted AMR/AMR-WB payloads. Attackers can send short packets whose TOC entries all set the F bit, causing out-of-bounds frame data to be copied into decoder output, disclosing memory or crashing the client.
items.title: GPAC through 26.07.0 Heap Out-of-Bounds Read via gf_rtp_parse_amr

items.summary: libical before 4.0.7 contains a denial of service vulnerability because icalparser_clean() does not reset the parser nesting level when reusing an icalparser. Attackers can submit a single malformed calendar with unclosed or mismatched BEGIN/END lines, causing later calendars to be silently dropped and memory to grow unbounded.
items.title: libical before 4.0.7 Denial of Service via icalparser_clean() Nesting Level

items.summary: Pion DTLS is a Go implementation of Datagram Transport Layer Security. From 1.2.2 until 3.1.13, the server state machine did not distinguish successful processing of the client certificate flight from completion of the handshake, so later traffic could revisit the same cached Certificate, ClientKeyExchange, and CertificateVerify messages. A malicious client can withhold Finished and send additional handshake traffic. Depending on the configured authentication policy, repeated work can include certificate parsing, handshake signature verification, and certificate-chain verification. The vulnerable endpoint must act as the DTLS server. Pion WebRTC applications are affected when they operate in that role. Repeated or concurrent attempts can consume excessive CPU resources, delay legitimate connections, and reduce service availability. The issue is fixed in version 3.1.13.
items.title: Pion DTLS: Repeated client certificate verification allows excessive CPU consumption during DTLS handshakes

items.summary: Pion DTLS is a Go implementation of Datagram Transport Layer Security. From 2.1.0 until 3.1.14, a server with a SessionStore saved the session ID and master secret after ClientKeyExchange, before receiving a valid Finished message and before enforcing the configured client-authentication checks. A remote client can omit its Certificate message, send ClientKeyExchange, leave the first handshake unfinished, and then resume the cached session using the master secret it learned during key exchange. The server must use a SessionStore and negotiate a certificate-based cipher suite. The attack can bypass client certificates required through RequireAnyClientCert or RequireAndVerifyClientCert, or a rejecting VerifyConnection callback. WebRTC users are not affected. The abbreviated handshake can allow unauthorized access to application data. The issue is fixed in version 3.1.14.
items.title: Pion DTLS: Client authentication bypass through premature DTLS 1.2 session caching

items.summary: RedVector before 8.1.0 contains a hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute commands by supplying the default redvector-dev-token bearer token. Attackers can call /api/python/execute or /api/process/execute-async to run Python scripts and commands as the server user, even via malicious web pages abusing permissive CORS against loopback instances.
items.title: RedVector before 8.1.0 Hard-Coded API Token RCE via REST Backend

items.summary: TypiCMS Core before 17.0.46 contains an insufficiently protected credentials vulnerability that allows authenticated users with "read users" permission to view plaintext api_token values for all users, including superusers, via the GET /api/users endpoint. Attackers can steal a superuser's non-expiring, non-rotatable api_token from the JSON response and use it to gain full superuser API access, enabling creation and deletion of users, roles, and all content.
items.title: TypiCMS Core before 17.0.46 API Token Disclosure via /api/users

items.summary: Pangolin before 1.21.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in isPathAllowed() in server/lib/pathMatch.ts that splits paths on literal slashes without percent-decoding or resolving dot segments. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send paths with encoded slashes and dot segments to match public bypass rules while backends serve protected paths.
items.title: Pangolin before 1.21.0 Authentication Bypass via URL-Encoded Slashes in Path Rules

items.summary: c-icap-server through 0.5.15 and 0.6.5 contains an out-of-bounds write in process_encapsulated() that allows unauthenticated attackers to corrupt heap memory by sending six Encapsulated entities. Attackers can send a single ICAP request whose sixth entity overwrites trash_entities[0], triggering use-after-free and double free in ci_request_destroy() during teardown.
items.title: c-icap-server through 0.5.15 and 0.6.5 Double Free via process_encapsulated()

items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in amirhamza05 Student-Management-System up to 449397e35d42e3779f14f0bfc654ab307103f7e3. This affects an unknown function of the file page_action/user/user_profile.php. The manipulation of the argument update_profile_info leads to cross-site request forgery. items.title: amirhamza05 Student-Management-System user_profile.php cross-site request forgery

items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the MXG demuxer's mxg_read_packet() that allows attackers to leak uninitialized heap memory through truncated marker segments. Attackers can supply a crafted MXG file ending in a truncated APP13 segment with a large declared length, causing uninitialized heap contents to be emitted as audio packet payload, for example into remuxed output files.
items.title: FFmpeg before 9.1 Uninitialized Heap Memory Disclosure via MXG Demuxer

items.summary: FFmpeg 8.0 before 9.1 contains an improper URL scheme validation vulnerability in the WHIP muxer that allows malicious WHIP servers to create or truncate local files via the Location header. Attackers can return a file: URL that dispose_session() opens read-write with truncation on teardown, destroying arbitrary user-writable files or redirecting requests to other protocols.
items.title: FFmpeg 8.0 before 9.1 Arbitrary File Truncation via WHIP Muxer Location Header

items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in libavformat/mmst.c that allows malicious MMS servers to crash clients by sending malformed ASF headers. Attackers can send an ASF header lacking a packet size or stream properties, causing mms_open() to return success after freeing state and crash on first read.
items.title: FFmpeg before 9.1 NULL Pointer Dereference via MMS-over-TCP ASF Header Handling

items.summary: FFmpeg 8.0 before 9.1 contains a use of uninitialized memory vulnerability in opus_parse_packet() in libavformat/rtpdec_opus.c that reads the Opus TOC byte from stale buffer memory when parsing empty RTP payloads. A malicious RTSP server or RTP sender can deliver an empty Opus payload to cause incorrect packet durations and leak bits of stale memory through pkt->duration.
items.title: FFmpeg 8.0 before 9.1 Uninitialized Memory Use via Opus RTP Depacketizer

items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in ff_rtp_send_vc2hq() in libavformat/rtpenc_vc2hq.c that accepts a Dirac next parse offset of zero. Attackers can supply crafted Dirac/VC-2 video remuxed to the RTP muxer, causing the parsing pointer to never advance and consume CPU indefinitely.
items.title: FFmpeg before 9.1 Infinite Loop via ff_rtp_send_vc2hq() in rtpenc_vc2hq.c

items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in peak_init_writer() and wav_write_packet() in libavformat/wavenc.c that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by supplying audio with zero channels. Attackers can provide a crafted PCM stream declaring no channels for WAV output with peak envelope enabled, causing out-of-bounds writes past peak_maxpos and peak_maxneg arrays, crashes, and potential code execution.
items.title: FFmpeg before 9.1 Heap Buffer Overflow via WAV Muxer Peak Envelope Writer

items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in rdt_parse_packet() in libavformat/rdt.c that allows remote attackers to crash applications by omitting the ASMRuleBook SDP attribute. Attackers can serve an RTSP session selecting RDT transport without ASMRuleBook, then send an RDT data packet to crash ffmpeg or ffprobe.
items.title: FFmpeg before 9.1 NULL Pointer Dereference via rdt_parse_packet()

items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an integer overflow in send_picture() of libavformat/rtpenc_vc2hq.c that leaves the bit reader without a buffer, causing a NULL pointer dereference. Attackers can supply a Dirac/VC-2 stream with a picture data unit of about 256 MiB or more to crash applications packetizing it to RTP.
items.title: FFmpeg before 9.1 NULL Pointer Dereference via VC-2 HQ RTP Packetizer

items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in filter_slice_rgba_planar() that allows attackers to read beyond lookup tables using unmasked high bit depth planar samples. Attackers can supply crafted video with samples exceeding the nominal depth, passed unchanged by rawvideo, to crash the application or leak heap contents into output video.
items.title: FFmpeg before 9.1 Heap Out-of-Bounds Read via colorchannelmixer filter_slice_rgba_planar()

items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_readeia608.c because build_histogram() does not clamp high bit depth luma samples to the nominal maximum. Attackers can supply crafted 9, 10, 12 or 14 bit gray or YUV video to corrupt heap memory, causing crashes or possibly code execution.
items.title: FFmpeg before 9.1 Heap Out-of-Bounds Write via readeia608 Filter Histogram

items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the lut1d filter in libavfilter/vf_lut3d.c that allows attackers to read heap memory by supplying planar high bit depth samples above the nominal depth. Attackers can craft 9, 10, 12 or 14 bit planar RGB video processed with a large 1D LUT to crash applications or disclose heap contents in output pixels.
items.title: FFmpeg before 9.1 Out-of-Bounds Read via lut1d Filter Interpolation

items.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.7.1 through 0.8.4, an incomplete IPv6 blocklist in AutoGPT's outbound SSRF protection allows authenticated users to reach local or private network services. Specifically, _is_ip_blocked and BLOCKED_IP_NETWORKS in autogpt_platform/backend/backend/util/request.py fail to reject the IPv6 unspecified address :: (which connects to ::1 on Linux) as well as 6to4, NAT64, Teredo, and deprecated IPv4-compatible IPv6 encodings. An attacker can pass :: directly to blocks/sql_query_block.py or blocks/email_block.py, or point URL-fetching blocks, web fetch, MCP servers, webhooks, or OAuth at a hostname whose AAAA record resolves to ::. On backends run directly on a host, this exposes unauthenticated internal RPC services and databases listening on ::1, though the default Docker Compose and single-container deployments bind internal services to IPv4 only. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.
items.title: AutoGPT: The unspecified address :: bypasses the request blocklist and reaches loopback services (SSRF)

items.summary: Trilium through 0.107.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability in updateNormalEntity() that allows malicious sync partners to inject SQL by supplying crafted entity names and column keys. Attackers can abuse /api/sync/changed or PUT /api/sync/update data to copy sessions, etapi_tokens and user_data into synced rows and write arbitrary database rows.

Attackers can send PATCH /api/db/Account/<username> setting roles to admin, overwrite password hashes, delete accounts, and read hashes to gain full administrative control.

items.summary: rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.13 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.0 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability in the users API that allows authenticated users to modify other accounts. Attackers can send a UserController::update request with an administrator's user id and new password, then log in as that administrator to take full control.
items.title: rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.13 and Pro before 8.4.0 Authorization Bypass via Users API

items.summary: TastyIgniter is an open-source online ordering, table reservation, and restaurant management system. Prior to 4.2.0, the User extension’s onRequestResetPassword() handler in src/Http/Controllers/Login.php calls resetPassword() and mailSendResetPasswordRequest() only when an account matches. The resulting database write and reset-email send take longer than the nonexistent-account path despite the endpoint returning the same response, allowing timing measurements against a production deployment using a synchronous queue and real SMTP transport to disclose valid staff or customer email addresses. The advisory’s local log-mailer test showed no measurable timing difference, so the signal depends on mail configuration and is useful for follow-on phishing or credential stuffing rather than direct account access. This issue is fixed in version 4.2.0.
items.title: TastyIgniter: Password-reset request endpoint leaks account existence via response-time side channel

items.summary: OpenEMR is a free and open source electronic health records and medical practice management application. Prior to 8.5.0, the staff-facing portal endpoints GET api/onsiteactivityviews and GET api/onsiteactivityview/{id}, mapped to OnsiteActivityView.Query and OnsiteActivityView.Read with p_acl = p_none in portal/patient/_app_config.php, are handled without an authorization check for an authenticated staff session whose bootstrap_pid is empty. portal/patient/_machine_config.php admits that authenticated staff session, and portal/patient/fwk/libs/verysimple/Phreeze/GenericRouter.php applies the route ACL only when bootstrap_pid is nonempty, so the staff request bypasses the p_none check. OnsiteActivityViewController::Query() returns records without patient scoping, and OnsiteActivityViewController::Read() loads a record by identifier without checking ACL or ownership; OnsiteActivityViewReporter::GetCustomQuery() joins portal activity to patient demographics and includes names, dates of birth, addresses, and Social Security numbers. Any authenticated staff account, including one without the patients/demo permission, can therefore read sensitive demographics for patients represented by an existing onsite_portal_activity row; at least one such row must exist for the endpoint to return patient data. This issue is fixed in version 8.5.0.
items.title: OpenEMR: Missing authorization on the portal OnsiteActivityView API discloses every patient's demographics and Social Security number

items.summary: EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit 03cc974, contains a blind server-side request forgery vulnerability in PDF export that allows authenticated attackers with the Form Manager role to make the server send HTTP or HTTPS requests to internal services. Question titles saved through POST /{shortname}/management/edit are rendered as raw markup in runnercontentinnerpdf.jsp, and the PDFRenderer resource loader fetches referenced images without checking whether the destination is on an internal network when a response is exported as a PDF.
items.title: EUSurvey 1.6 Blind SSRF via PDF Export

items.summary: EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit de1145c, contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the public POST /editcontribution/{code} endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite another respondent's submitted answers. The handler in ContributionController selects the survey and answer set from body parameters by numeric contribution ID and never checks that the private edit code in the URL matches that contribution, so an attacker who knows a contribution ID can replace its saved answers without the respondent's edit link.
items.title: EUSurvey 1.6 Unauthenticated Contribution Overwrite via Edit Endpoint

items.summary: EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit 118facd, contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the public POST /runner/draft/runner endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite another participant's saved draft and obtain its private invitation token. The draft save handler in RunnerController and AnswerService loads an existing draft by invitation alone without checking that the submitted survey, participation group and invitation belong together, then replaces the draft's answers, reassigns it to the submitted survey, and returns a resume link containing the private invitation token.
items.title: EUSurvey 1.6 Authorization Bypass via /runner/draft/runner

items.summary: Hermes Agent is an open-source autonomous AI agent built by Nous Research for running tool-using workflows across CLI, desktop, and messaging interfaces. From 0.21.6 to 0.23.1, when Bot Desktop is hosted inside a non-local terminal backend, the agent process reads a backend-writable screen environment file without validating keys or values and merges its entries into the environment of processes started on the agent machine. Specifically, when terminal.backend is set to docker or ssh (or a plugin backend declaring supports_streams) with placement auto or terminal, _published() in tools/bot_desktop/sandbox_host.py accepts arbitrary KEY=VALUE lines from the hermes-bot-desktop env file and propagates them via tools/bot_desktop/runtime.py into the browser harness, computer-use helpers, and local terminal children. Code running inside the terminal backend can therefore set variables such as LD_PRELOAD, DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES, or PATH and gain code execution on the agent machine as the gateway user upon a subsequent browser or computer-use spawn, exposing credentials, tokens, and session history under the Hermes home directory. The default local backend, backends that cannot host a screen (Modal, Daytona, and Vercel), and Hermes Cloud in its default configuration are not affected. This issue is fixed in version 0.23.2.
items.title: Hermes Agent: Missing key validation for Bot Desktop screen environment file in non-local terminal backends

items.summary: sdcb Chats 1.10.0 before 1.17.1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in GetAssignedUserDetails that allows assigned non-admin users to read other users' per-user MCP headers. items.summary: KindleEar 3.0.0 through 3.5.3 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated non-admin users to run Python code by uploading malicious recipes. Attackers can submit crafted recipe source to the /recipe/upload action, which calibre compile_recipe executes via exec() without sandboxing, gaining root code execution in the Docker container and access to password hashes.
items.title: KindleEar 3.0.0 through 3.5.3 Authenticated RCE via Recipe Upload

items.summary: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains an uninitialized pointer dereference vulnerability because the File_Mpeg4_Descriptors constructor leaves the IsCmaf pointer holding stale heap contents. Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file with an AAC/USAC decoder specific descriptor so File_Usac::Streams_Finish_Conformance_Profile dereferences an invalid address, crashing the application.
items.title: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 Uninitialized Pointer Dereference via File_Usac Conformance Profile

items.summary: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains a divide-by-zero vulnerability in TimeCode::FromString() that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying hour-unit timestamps with fewer than three fractional digits. Attackers can craft a TTML file whose begin or end attribute contains such a timestamp, causing MediaInfo or embedding applications to crash with SIGFPE when opened.
items.title: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 Divide-by-Zero via TimeCode::FromString

items.summary: ERPSaaS 3.7.9 through 3.47.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated company users to inject script markup through unescaped client and company address fields. Attackers can store script in address lines rendered by getFormattedAddressHtml() via unescaped Blade output, executing in browsers of users viewing, previewing or printing invoices and estimates.
items.title: ERPSaaS 3.7.9 through 3.47.0 Stored XSS via Client and Company Address Fields

items.summary: Contiki-NG through 5.2 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in icmp_in() in os/net/ipv6/multicast/mpl.c that allows unauthenticated attackers to hang nodes via crafted MPL control messages. Attackers on the same link can send an MPL data message to create a seed entry, then an all-zero bit vector control message causing index wraparound and denial of service.
items.title: Contiki-NG through 5.2 Infinite Loop via MPL Control Message in icmp_in()

items.summary: Convoy before 26.6.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in /portal-api single-resource handlers that allows portal link token holders to access other tenants' resources by ID. Attackers with another tenant's resource IDs in the same project can read endpoint signing secrets and webhook payloads, rotate secrets, pause or delete endpoints, and force event re-delivery.
items.title: Convoy before 26.6.0 Cross-Tenant IDOR via Portal API By-ID Handlers

items.summary: Kerberos Agent before 3.14.4 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens because JWTMiddleWare() falls back to the hard-coded key TOBECHANGED. Attackers can sign HS256 tokens with arbitrary username and role claims to access /api and /config routes, exposing RTSP, ONVIF, Hub and encryption keys, rewriting configuration, and stopping the camera.
items.title: Kerberos Agent before 3.14.4 Authentication Bypass via Hard-coded JWT Signing Key

items.summary: AiSOC before 23.6.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the agents service that allows authenticated users to read other tenants' investigation runs by supplying their run_id. Attackers can query GET /api/v1/investigations/{run_id}, report variants, the WebSocket stream, or agent-runs routes to obtain audit logs, forensic output, and incident reports.
items.title: AiSOC before 23.6.1 Cross-Tenant Investigation Disclosure via Agents Service run_id

items.summary: Future AGI before 1.51.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in ACSView.post that allows authenticated members of any organization to take over accounts in other organizations by asserting arbitrary e-mail addresses. Attackers can register a controlled identity provider through IDPUploadViews to obtain sessions as cross-tenant users, and can modify or delete other organizations' identity-provider configurations.
items.title: Future AGI before 1.51.0 Cross-Tenant Account Takeover via SAML ACSView

items.summary: Sim 0.5.61 before 0.9.41 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows write-level workspace members to change workflow MCP server visibility without admin permission. Attackers can set isPublic via POST or PATCH to /api/mcp/workflow-servers, exposing deployed workflows to unauthenticated invocation through /api/mcp/serve.
items.title: Sim 0.5.61 before 0.9.41 Incorrect Authorization via Workflow MCP Server Visibility

items.summary: Umbraco CMS 17.4.0 before 17.8.2 and 18.0.0 before 18.3.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability because MemberValueSetBuilder.GetValueSets writes sensitive member properties into the Examine members index. Backoffice users with Settings and Members access but outside the Sensitive data group can search the index via the Examine Management dashboard or Management API to read hidden sensitive member values.
items.title: Umbraco CMS 17.4.0 before 17.8.2 and 18.x before 18.3.2 Sensitive Data Disclosure via Examine Index

items.summary: ZITADEL 4.19.5 before 4.20.3 contains a host header injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect notification links by placing a trusted host in the userinfo portion of the x-zitadel-public-host header. Attackers knowing a victim's login name can harvest single-use codes from password-reset links sent to their host, reset passwords, and take over accounts including administrators.
items.title: ZITADEL 4.19.5 before 4.20.3 Account Takeover via x-zitadel-public-host Header

items.title: yangzongzhuan RuoYi Role Management User-View view.html renderUserCards cross site scripting

This impacts the function Assimp::ColladaLoader::CreateMesh of the file code/AssetLib/Collada/ColladaLoader.cpp. Executing a manipulation can lead to out-of-bounds read. items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in Webkul Bagisto up to 2.4.12. Affected by this vulnerability is the function Success of the file packages/Webkul/PayU/src/Http/Controllers/PayUController.php of the component Payu Payment Gateway. Executing a manipulation of the argument Status can lead to insufficient verification of data authenticity. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. Upgrading to version 2.4.13 addresses this issue. Upgrading the affected component is recommended.
items.title: Webkul Bagisto Payu Payment Gateway PayUController.php success data authenticity

items.summary: Ground Station before 0.8.25 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated non-administrator operators to write files outside data/decoded via the post_process_pipeline value. Attackers can insert ../ sequences into a scheduled observation's IQ task configuration so SatDump creates directories, overwrites same-named files, and recursively deletes created trees on failure.
items.title: Ground Station before 0.8.25 Path Traversal via SatDump post_process_pipeline

items.summary: Donetick before 0.1.86 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the GET /api/v1/assets/*filepath route that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass URL signature checks by prefixing paths with profiles/. Attackers who know a private upload's storage key can request profiles/../users/<id>/<uuid>.<ext> to retrieve private attachments without a signature or login.
items.title: Donetick before 0.1.86 Path Traversal via AssetHandler

items.summary: VoidAuth before 1.19.2 contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability that allows attackers to retain account access because the POST /reset_password/passkey/end handler never calls endUserSessions(). Attackers holding a stolen session cookie keep authenticated access to the victim's account even after the victim recovers it by registering a new passkey.
items.title: VoidAuth before 1.19.2 Insufficient Session Expiration via Passkey Account Recovery

items.summary: Zipline before 4.8.3 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated OIDC users to make the server fetch arbitrary URLs via the userinfo picture claim. Attackers who control their picture claim at the identity provider can force fetchToDataURL() to request internal or cloud-metadata URLs and read responses from their stored avatar.
items.title: Zipline before 4.8.3 Server-Side Request Forgery via OIDC Avatar URL

items.summary: OpenOLAT 20.2.2 before 20.3.12, 21.0.0 before 21.0.7, and 21.1.0 before 21.1.2 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the TranscodingDeliveryDispatcher notifyResult callback endpoint. Unauthenticated attackers can POST crafted TranscoderJobResult JSON with attacker-supplied URLs to overwrite transcoded video and audio files and force server-side requests.
items.title: OpenOLAT 20.2.2 before 20.3.12, 21.0.7, and 21.1.2 Missing Authentication via notifyResult

items.summary: binary-parser before 2.3.1 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers controlling parser definitions to inject JavaScript through string-typed options passed unvalidated by Context.generateOption(). Attackers can supply crafted length, lengthInBytes, key, tag, offset, or namely() alias values to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the Node.js process when the parser is compiled.
items.title: binary-parser before 2.3.1 Code Injection via String-Typed Parser Options

items.summary: oasdiff 1.24.0 before 1.34.1 fails to enforce --allow-external-refs=false when --open is used, because the recordingReader() capture reader in load/capture.go never applies the external-reference policy. Attackers supplying an untrusted OpenAPI spec can use external $ref values to read local files or trigger HTTP requests, with contents uploaded in the review bundle.
items.title: oasdiff 1.24.0 before 1.34.1 External Reference Policy Bypass via --open

items.summary: Kitty 0.43.0 before 0.51.0 contains a terminal escape sequence injection vulnerability that allows attackers to emit escape sequences by crafting malicious file or archive member names. When a victim highlights such an entry in the choose-files kitten preview panel, unsanitized names are written raw, enabling OSC 52 clipboard overwrites, OSC 8 links, window title changes, or screen spoofing.
items.title: Kitty 0.43.0 before 0.51.0 Terminal Escape Injection via choose-files Preview

items.summary: Lightdash before 3.212.0 contains an insufficiently protected credentials vulnerability in getGitlabInstallationRepoReadAccess that sends the organization GitLab app token to unverified hosts. Project developers can set the dbt connection host_domain to an attacker-controlled server and capture the token when the AI agent reads the repository, gaining access to every reachable repository.
items.title: Lightdash before 3.212.0 Credential Exposure via AI Writeback GitLab Read Access

items.summary: Vim 9.2.0405 before 9.2.1352 contains a security bypass vulnerability in expand_tag_fname() that allows attackers to evade 'tagsecure' URL checks by escaping URLs in tags file entries. Attackers can supply a crafted tags file in a cloned repository so that jumping to a tag makes netrw fetch an attacker-controlled URL leaking environment variable values.
items.title: Vim 9.2.0405 before 9.2.1352 tagsecure Bypass via Escaped URL in Tags File

items.summary: Dashy 4.0.0 before 4.9.12 contains a credential disclosure vulnerability in isLocalRequest that attaches user credentials to lookalike hosts due to prefix-only origin checks. Attackers can lure logged-in users to a crafted ?config= link pointing to a lookalike host, capturing bearer tokens or HTTP auth headers to read configuration and stored API keys, or modify them when the victim is an admin.
items.title: Dashy 4.0.0 before 4.9.12 Credential Disclosure via isLocalRequest Prefix Check

items.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in PLYImporter::LoadFace and PLYImporter::createFromeTriStrip that fails to validate face vertex indices against the vertex count. Attackers can supply a crafted PLY file whose out-of-range indices cause GenVertexNormalsProcess::GenMeshVertexNormals to write normals outside the heap buffer, crashing the application or potentially enabling code execution.
items.title: Assimp through 6.0.6 Out-of-Bounds Write via PLY Importer Face Indices

items.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an invalid pointer dereference vulnerability in glTFImporter::ImportEmbeddedTextures that derives the texture format hint without checking the strchr result. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file with an embedded image mime type lacking a slash to crash the importing application.
items.title: Assimp through 6.0.6 Invalid Pointer Dereference via glTF 1.0 Embedded Image

items.summary:
Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in ColladaParser::ReadPrimitives that allows attackers to exhaust memory via non-numeric index values. Attackers can supply a crafted Collada file whose

index list contains a non-digit character, causing endless zero-index appends until the importing process crashes.
items.title: Assimp through 6.0.6 Infinite Loop via Collada ReadPrimitives Index List

items.summary: MemberPress Members before 3.3.1, with the Block Permissions add-on enabled, contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated Author-level users to crash pages by saving a non-string blockPermissionsMessage block attribute. Attackers can store a JSON array in the attribute so wpautop() in get_block_replacement_content() throws a PHP 8 TypeError, causing fatal errors on post, home, search, and REST pages for unauthorized viewers.
items.title: Members WordPress Plugin before 3.3.1 Denial of Service via Block Permissions Message Attribute

items.summary: dsniff through 2.5a2 contains an integer underflow in decode_sniffer() in decode_sniffer.c that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to write past the global obuf buffer. Attackers can send a UDP datagram to port 2001 on a monitored segment with a 4096-byte string, disabling base64_pton bounds checks to corrupt memory and crash dsniff.
items.title: dsniff through 2.5a2 Integer Underflow Out-of-Bounds Write via decode_sniffer()

items.summary: Wfuzz through 3.1.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows malicious target servers to inject script by returning crafted links written unescaped into HTML reports. When the links script and html printer are used, attacker-supplied href values close the unquoted anchor tag and execute JavaScript when the operator opens the report.
items.title: wfuzz through 3.1.1 Stored XSS via HTML Report Printer

items.summary: catdoc through 0.95 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in copy_unicode_string() in src/xlsparse.c that allows attackers to read past buffers via an unchecked string character count. Attackers can supply a crafted .xls file declaring 0xFFFF two-byte characters in LABEL, STRING, or SST records to disclose adjacent memory through xls2csv output or crash the process.
items.title: catdoc through 0.95 Out-of-Bounds Read via xls2csv copy_unicode_string

items.summary: catdoc through 0.95 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the MULRK record handler of process_item() in src/xlsparse.c that allows attackers to read past the static rec buffer via a crafted end column. Attackers can supply a crafted .xls workbook or BIFF stream with a large endcol to xls2csv to disclose adjacent process memory as CSV cells or crash the process.
items.title: catdoc through 0.95 Out-of-Bounds Read in xls2csv MULRK Record Handler

items.summary: A path traversal vulnerability was found in gvproxy, the network forwarder provided by the gvisor-tap-vsock package. The unauthenticated /services/forwarder/expose endpoint does not validate the caller-supplied socket path, allowing an attacker to delete arbitrary files on the host system.
items.title: Gvisor-tap-vsock: gvisor-tap-vsock: unathenticated arbitrary file deletion on the host via /expose

items.summary:
A Code Injection and Missing Authentication vulnerability in Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) versions 1.7.0 (and 2.0.0a1) through 1.28.1 (and 2.0.0a2) on Python (OSS), Cloud Run, and GKE allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server hosting the ADK instance.

This vulnerability was patched in versions 1.28.1 and 2.0.0a2.


Customers need to redeploy the upgraded ADK to their production environments. In addition, if they are running ADK Web locally, they also need to upgrade their local instance.
items.title: CVE-2026-4810

items.summary: DOMPurify is a DOM-only, super-fast, uber-tolerant XSS sanitizer for HTML, MathML and SVG. It has been discovered that malicious HTML using special nesting techniques can bypass the depth checking added to DOMPurify in recent releases. It was also possible to use Prototype Pollution to weaken the depth check. This renders dompurify unable to avoid cross site scripting (XSS) attacks. This issue has been addressed in versions 2.5.4 and 3.1.3 of DOMPurify. All users are advised to upgrade. There are no known workarounds for this vulnerability.
items.title: Tampering by prototype polution in DOMPurify
